lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular 2D lattice across the mid-lateral flank, forming distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to create a series of grid-like anchor nodes along the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the dorsal-lateral boundary, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition with higher luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex labyrinthine pattern of high-luminance pixel clusters is observed in the transition zone immediately posterior to the head and dorsal to the gill slits.
